name: Hours Arcade
summary: A low mosque with three broad vaults holds a clock inside its central facade, connecting architecture to prayer time.
why: Three rounded roof masses join one continuous prayer hall. The central vault and clock share x54; both side vaults and their entrances mirror at x38 and x70. The clock face is a true circular cutout with connected hands, preserving the time cue in monochrome. One short minaret grows directly from the left hall.
risk: The multi-vault roof carries more architectural detail than the other two. At 24 pixels, the clock is a compact open circle and the side entrances simplify.

palette.name: HOURS ARCADE / STONE + IVORY + WARM METAL

reasonToChoose: You want the logo to express both the mosque and the app’s prayer-time function.
